Setup.Name: Constant value
Setup.Description: Ignores the payload and returns a constant value.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Provides a constant value"
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/error"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "sensor.errors"
          Description: "Counts all sensor errors."
          Instrument: Counter
          Value: "1"
